'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Anthony Massung DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Massung]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).

Handwritten Xerox form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself|VB9-D-separatistuprising-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
